title: "adv2015_5"
format: html
editor: visual
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
input <- readLines("nices")
```

```{r}
input %>% 
  str_subset(pattern = "[aieou].*[aieou].*[aieou]") %>% 
  str_subset(pattern = "([A-Za-z)\\1") %>% 
  str_subset(pattern = "ab|cd|pq|xy", negate = TRUE) %>% 
  length()
```

```{r}
input %>% 
  str_subset(pattern = "(..).*\\1") %>% 
  str_subset(pattern = "(.).\\1") %>% 
  length()
```
